name: zfmv_action_play_avi_end
description: zFMV_ActionPlayAvi::End tears down the stream allocated by Begin, invokes the stream destructor, releases the stream storage through operator delete, and clears the stream pointer.
known_limits: Tier C only; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zFMV PlayAvi/source-file pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation for 0x463820 validates the thiscall End contract: read self->stream, if non-null call zFMV_Stream::Destructor then operator delete on the same pointer, and unconditionally clear self->stream to null.
The dependency frontier has no source blockers: zFMV_Stream::Destructor has accepted limited source dependencies and tier C equivalence, and operator delete is a CRT provider.
The native smoke verifies the Begin-allocated stream is passed to operator delete during End and that the stream pointer is cleared; it also exercises the idempotent null-stream End path.
